description: Fee, collateral ratio, liquidation price and headroom for depositing collateral and minting, with the contracts' exact math at the current oracle price. Warns when the price is stale or the market is closed. Read-only.

collateral.description: Collateral to add, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

mintTokens.description: Synth to mint, in synth tokens as a decimal string, e.g. "0.0189"

mintValueUsdg.description: Exposure to mint, converted to tokens at the current price, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

owner.description: Optional: include this wallet's existing position

name: quote_position
title: Quote a position
